text: Nadia's mum is having her hip replaced on Thursday morning. Nadia sounded exhausted, she's been driving over every evening to help.
Coffee with Gareth. His wife Rebecca finally got a date for her knee surgery, the 12th at half 9. He's taking the week off to look after the kids.
Remind me to text Mateo on Friday afternoon to see how his dad's scan went.
Akira is back home after four nights in hospital. Appendix, apparently it was close to bursting. She's not allowed to lift anything until early December.
Eduardo mentioned his brother Paolo is moving to Lisbon over the summer. Eduardo is gutted but trying to be supportive about it.
Need to book the boiler service and renew the car insurance before the end of the month.
Called Ciara back. Her daughter has grommets going in sometime next week, and Ciara is more nervous about it than the kid is. I should ring her the evening after.

Yusuf's cataract op has been cancelled again, the hospital rang him yesterday morning. He's fed up. They're saying maybe early March now. He can't drive in the meantime, so his daughter Leah has been taking him to the shops on Saturdays and his wife does the rest. I should offer him a lift to his clinic appointment on the 18th at quarter past two.
Giulia and her partner Luis are hosting a housewarming on Saturday the 7th from 4pm. Bring wine, Luis doesn't drink beer.
Met Valentina at the school gate. Her son starts at the new secondary in January and she's worried he won't settle. Her husband is working away until Christmas, so she's doing it all on her own.
Ibrahim had his gallbladder out on Monday. Don't forget to drop round some soup tomorrow evening, he's off solid food for a bit.
Leah is a big climber, goes to the bouldering wall three times a week. Also hates mushrooms.
Hoang said his grandmother passed away last weekend. The funeral is in Hanoi so he's flying out on Wednesday night and won't be back until the 3rd. Must send a card before he goes.
Pooja's sister Deepa is expecting twins in the spring! Pooja is going to be an auntie for the first time and couldn't stop grinning.

Long chat with Aneesh about his dad. He had a minor stroke a fortnight ago and is in a rehab ward now. Aneesh and his brother are taking turns visiting, mornings and evenings. His mum is coping, just about. Aneesh is clearly struggling but kept saying he's fine. I need to check in with him sometime next week, and maybe offer to take the dog out so he gets a break. His dog is a greyhound called Pip.

Joe Lewis from accounts is retiring at the end of November. Leaving do is on the 28th at 6, upstairs at the Crown. Rebecca is organising a collection and wants everyone's money by the 21st. Joe is into birdwatching and has mentioned wanting a better pair of binoculars, so I'll suggest that. His wife and grandkids are coming to the do as a surprise.
Mai mentioned she's been dropping hints to Colm about a proper espresso machine for their anniversary. Their anniversary is the 19th.
Physio for my shoulder moved to Tuesday at 10:15. Pharmacy run after.
Amara's little boy, Joe, had his tonsils out this morning and is already demanding ice cream. Amara says he's bouncing around. Ask her on Thursday whether he's back at nursery.
Katarzyna, or Kasia as everyone calls her, passed her driving test today on the third attempt. She was so nervous going in.
Omar's wedding is off. He and Lucy split up a couple of weeks ago. He seemed okay, but I'd like to take him for a pint sometime soon.
Kenji's wife is in hospital with pneumonia. He's juggling the kids, work and visiting hours. Remind me to offer to do the school run on Monday and Tuesday morning.

Neha starts her new job at the council on the 1st. She's a bit anxious about the commute but excited overall. Her old manager is throwing her a small leaving lunch on Friday at 1, and her husband Santiago is collecting her afterwards because they're off to his sister's for the weekend. She's been in that job nine years, so it's a big change.
Santiago's mum is coming over from Bogotá for three weeks in early December. He's repainting the spare room for her.
Quiet week. Nothing much to note except that the allotment needs digging over before the frost.
James told me his partner is having a biopsy on Friday at 2pm. Results probably end of next week. He asked me not to make a fuss, so just a quiet message on Friday evening.
Rebecca is recovering well from the knee op, walking with one crutch now. Gareth says she's going stir crazy and has binged every series of Bake Off.
Ran into Deepa at the shops. Her husband Aneesh's dad is out of rehab and home since Sunday. She said the whole family is relieved.
Paolo's daughter Giulia has her first ballet recital on Sunday at 3. He's invited me along. I'm going, and I'm bringing my niece.
I've booked the dentist for the 14th at 8:40 and the eye test for sometime the following week.

Eamon is having his ACL reconstruction in early January. He's a keen five-a-side player and is dreading the months out. His girlfriend Mai is going to move in for a few weeks after to help. He's also hinted he'd love a decent pair of noise-cancelling headphones to get him through the recovery, which could be a nice thing to chip in on with the lads. His mum is flying over from Cork the week after the op too.

Phoned Mrs Haddad next door. Her husband is in for a heart bypass on Wednesday, so she'll be at the hospital most of the day. I'm feeding their cat Mango while she's out. Their son Omar is driving down from Leeds on Tuesday night and staying until the weekend, which she's relieved about. She admitted she hasn't been sleeping. Need to pop round on Thursday evening with a lasagne and see how they're both getting on.
Dr Osei said my blood results are fine. Follow-up appointment in six months.
Valentina's son settled in far better than she expected. He's already joined the chess club and made a friend called Mateo.
Should ask Colm whether his mum got her hearing aids sorted after Monday's appointment.
Uncle Eduardo had his pacemaker fitted yesterday. Mum says he's grumpy but fine. Visiting hours are 2 till 4 and 6 till 8, so we're going Saturday afternoon.
Nadia loves anything to do with Studio Ghibli and is collecting the soundtracks on vinyl. Good to remember for her birthday in March.

Hoang is back from the funeral. He looked tired. His mum is staying with him for a while, possibly until the end of the month, and his sister Mai is joining them for a few days over half term. He said the service was lovely and that his grandmother's whole village came. He's back at work on Monday but only doing mornings for the first week.

Lunch with Pooja and Neha. Neha's brother Omar has an interview at a law firm tomorrow at 11 and he's a wreck about it. Pooja's dad has his bowel screening sometime over the next fortnight. Text Neha tomorrow evening to see how Omar got on.
Gareth's dog Rolo had to have a tooth out on Monday. Poor thing is on soft food for a week.
Ciara's daughter's grommets went fine. She can hear properly now and keeps telling everyone the telly is too loud.
Akira's wife has her six-week check after the C-section on the 22nd. The baby is gorgeous, a girl called Mai. Akira is running on about three hours' sleep.
Don't forget the parcel for Lucy needs posting by Thursday lunchtime, otherwise it won't reach Dublin for her birthday on the 30th.

Spoke to Luis about his back. He's been signed off for two weeks with a slipped disc and is waiting on an MRI, hopefully before the end of the month. He's worried it'll affect the contract renewal at work. His partner Giulia is doing most of the lifting at home, literally. I should send him that list of physios Dr Kim recommended, and check how the MRI went once it's done.
Yusuf mentioned his son Ibrahim has his final-year exams in May and wants to study medicine. Yusuf is quietly very proud.
Mateo's dad's scan was clear. Huge relief all round. Mateo is taking him out for a celebratory curry on Saturday night.
Santiago's partner Amara has a hospital appointment on Monday at 9 to discuss her migraines. She's vegetarian and allergic to nuts, worth knowing for the dinner.
Eamon's surgery has been pushed back to the end of January. He's annoyed because he'd already booked the time off work.
Katarzyna has a new kitten called Pierogi. She sent about forty photos.
Meeting with Joe went well. He's taking on the Manchester project from the start of next month and asked if I could cover his Tuesdays sometime in the spring.
Remember to ask Kenji how his wife is doing when I see him on Wednesday morning. She was discharged at the weekend but is still very weak.

Leah's mum fell and broke her wrist on Sunday afternoon. Leah drove up straight away and is staying with her for the rest of the week. Her mum has a fracture clinic appointment on Friday at 11 to see whether it needs pinning, and Leah is dreading having to tell her she can't drive for six weeks. Her brother Colm can't get time off, which Leah is a bit sore about.
Need to sort travel insurance before we fly on the 9th, and ring the GP about my repeat prescription first thing Monday.
Giulia's dad is having a hernia repair later this month. She doesn't want to make a big deal of it.
Colm, who goes by Col at work, is training for the Dublin marathon at the end of October. His knees are not happy but he's determined.
Neha's brother Omar didn't get the law firm job, but they've asked him to reapply over the summer. Neha says he's taking it on the chin.
Mai's grandad is in a care home now after his fall. Mai visits him every Sunday morning and says he still beats her at cards.

Coffee with Nadia this morning. Her mum's hip op went well and she's already moaning about the hospital food. Nadia is going back on Thursday night to help her settle at home. She also mentioned her husband James is going for a promotion, interview sometime next week. Remind me to wish him luck the day before.
James got the promotion. He starts as team lead after Christmas. Send congratulations.
Pooja's dad's screening came back clear. She said she'd been worrying for weeks and can finally sleep.
